_comment: Gold set for retrieval evaluation. Gold chunks are resolved at eval time by searching anchor phrases inside chunk CONTENT (not section headings), because the PyMuPDF heading detector produces unreliable headings on real arXiv PDFs (Attention Is All You Need ingests as one 'Document Content' section; BERT yields numeric garbage headings). A chunk is gold if it contains ANY anchor. Section-agnostic and survives re-ingestion.
_note_papers: Keys map to regex matched against the stored paper title, which is the arXiv stamp line (e.g. 'arXiv:1706.03762v7 [cs.CL] ...').
